## Why This Is Asked
Practical KCA workflow for ephemeral compute in multi-tenant analytics with cross-cloud mobility.

## Key Concepts
- KCA + SPIFFE identities
- Hardware/software attestation
- Short TTL certs and rotation
- Cross-region trust anchors
- Offline revocation and local caches
- Tenant isolation and audits
- PQC readiness

## Code Example
```javascript
function requestCert(notebookId, tenant, spiffeId){
  const att = regionalAttest(notebookId);
  const csr = buildCsr({spiffeId, tenant, scope:'analytics'});
  return centralKCA.issue(csr, {ttl:300, policies:['analytics']});
}
```
